messages:
alex: Heads-up: CI perf alert flagged a memory drift in KV pager during long-context nightly runs. Repro on shaded Llama-2-13B config.

ci-bot: perf-alert: kv-pager memory-growth +32% in 7d; regression window 2904800000 -> 2905000000; check job 2905001111 :warning:

maya: I saw weird cross-request tokens when we enable `batch_split=true` + `kernel=fast_attn_v2` yesterday. Might be alignment rounding.

sriram: Can you paste the minimal repro and logs?

alex: Repro snippet (quick):
```text
cmd: ./rundebug --model llama2-13b --seq 8192 --batch-split 2 --kernel fast_attn_v2
logs:
[REQ 0x7f] kv_slot=12 offset=238 align=3
[REQ 0x8a] kv_slot=12 offset=0 align=0
Warning: KV page overlap detected: slot 12 reuse w/o eviction
```

liz: That overlap line is interesting. Looks like tag rotation didn't increment when batch split resumes.

jordan: I can repro locally with our long-context harness. Steps: send 2 concurrent requests with different request ids each ~8k tokens, then resume batched continuation. I see stale keys returned from previous request on 2nd request at token ~2100.

maya: Possibly when kernel switches we skip a memcpy that applies alignment padding. Kernel switch path bypasses `apply_padding_for_slot()` in `kv_page_manager.cpp`.

sriram: Quick check: any change in slot-tagging code last week? @liz

liz: I touched slot-tagging in 2899990000 to add tombstone compacting. Reopening that diff now.

alex: Temporary mitigation: add strict fence check in pager: if tag != request_tag then evict slot before reuse. Will add patch and run nightly.

ci-bot: deploy-preview: alex/kvmitig-evict-290500 queued, presubmit ok, benchmark: +1.2% latency p50, memory growth fixed in quick-run. :white_check_mark:

jordan: If we add evict, watch perf; evict on hot path may hurt throughput. Maybe we can set a fast-path assert only in debug builds and a more selective evict in release when misalignment detected.

maya: I also noticed alignment mismatch only happens when sequence length % page_size != 0 and batch_split>1. Logs show `align` values nonzero and `offset` wrapping.

sriram: Assigning: alex to implement mitig, liz to audit tombstone compacting, jordan to run perf harness. Let's track in a GH issue and add a small reproducer to evict test suite.

alex: Filed GH: rdlw/infra#3271 with repro and logs. I'll PR today.

ci-bot: issue-link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/3271
